Unregistered SRVF FPCA or genuine native R elastic Karcher shape FPCA

etr_fit_elastic_fpca.Rd

The opt-in mathematical-source R path performs genuine nonidentity elastic phase alignment of multivariate open curves through SRVF Karcher mean, dynamic-programming time warping and tangent-geodesic shape PCA. It reports fitted warps, aligned coordinates, PCA scores, a ten-deformation principal-direction array, and mean curve in the same scientific axis ordering as frozen Python 1.2 fit_elastic_fpca. The unchanged default still returns the historical unregistered/identity-warp native FPCA alternative.

Usage

etr_fit_elastic_fpca(trajectories, n_components = 3L,
  rotation = FALSE, scale_curves = FALSE, lam = 0,
  method = "identity_only", strict_source_record = FALSE)

Arguments

trajectories

A complete finite numeric common-grid etr_trajectory_set with at least two measured dimensions. The native R elastic source requires at least three curves and five observation times.

n_components

Positive integer number of principal directions. In native R elastic source mode, this cannot exceed n_curves - 1.

rotation

Boolean. Source-scientific mode optionally aligns rigid rotations in true SRVF shape space. Legacy identity mode requires FALSE.

scale_curves

Boolean. Source-scientific mode optionally normalizes SRVF curve shape scale. Legacy mode requires FALSE.

lam

Nonnegative finite elastic reparameterization penalty; the legacy identity mode requires zero.

method

"identity_only" by default, preserving the original native unregistered SRVF result. To perform genuine elastic source- scientific Karcher dynamic programming, explicitly specify method="DP" and strict_source_record=TRUE. R native mode does not implement Python RBFGS.

strict_source_record

Boolean. FALSE returns historical native unregistered SRVF functional principal components with identity warping. TRUE calls the independent genuine native R fdasrvf (>= 2.5.1) library for Karcher SRVF registration and geodesic tangent-space shape PCA, with no Python backend.

Value

With default parameters, an etr_unregistered_srvf_fpca native R scientific alternative retaining identity warping. With strict_source_record=TRUE, method="DP", a typed etr_native_elastic_karcher_pca_scientific_record with aligned native trajectory (curves x times x channels), warping_functions (curves x times), scores (curves x components), principal_directions (channels x times x components x 10), mean_curve (channels x times), source-scientific provenance, and actual R fdacurve and curve_pca under native_backend_object and native_pca_object. backend_object=NULL deliberately does NOT fabricate a Python fdasrsf.fdacurve.

Details

The source-scientific native R algorithm uses the genuine fdasrvf package, which is optional. This is NOT a numerical clone of Python fdasrsf: Python starts Karcher iterations from the first curve and executes a separate srvf_align, whereas the independent modern native R implementation starts at a medoid and returns already aligned reconstructions. The scientific SRVF/elastic-Karcher/geodesic-PCA objective is implemented, but exact DP warps, eigenvector signs, backend class identity, Python exceptions and optional RBFGS behavior remain uncertified. See docs/native-elastic-fdasrvf-karcher-source-20261113.md and inst/extdata/native_scoped_elastic_submethod_gaps_20261113.csv.
